subject: website
name: Devcon
summary: Devcon's link page at devcon.eth, open source (GPL-3.0). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it reads links from devcon.org's API, images from Supabase and records from a public RPC endpoint.

connections.note: Content from servers the team runs, read when the page opens.
